outcome: Rate of emergency intrapartum cesarean section
cohort: 126 pregnancies complicated by complex fetal congenital heart disease and 45,069 non-anomalous singleton infants ≥500 g (controls)
finding: Pregnancies complicated by complex fetal congenital heart disease had significantly higher rates of emergency intrapartum cesarean section, preterm delivery, and induction of labor.
mod_finding: The increase in emergency cesarean section in the fetal congenital heart disease group was primarily due to non-reassuring fetal status and was more pronounced in multiparous women.
